description: Source code for the 'SetExam' page in an online examination system. It handles question and exam setup functionalities, including course selection based on semester, adding multiple-choice questions, setting up exam details, and navigation.

classes.name: SetExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the 'SetExam' ASP.NET page, responsible for course selection, question addition, exam setup, navigation, and handling user interactions.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles initial page load; currently contains commented out code for session-based question number handling.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the AdminPanel page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the AdminQueue page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to the AdminLeaderboard page.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates the course dropdown list based on the selected semester.

methods.name: clearB_Click
methods.description: Clears input fields for question and exam details.

methods.name: AddQB_Click
methods.description: Adds a new MCQ question to the database, updates question number, and alerts user.

methods.name: setB_Click
methods.description: Creates an exam record in the database for the selected course and navigates back to the admin panel.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates course dropdown list based on the new semester selection.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates question number based on the selected course.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and transfers to login page.
